newsitem.title: USA: John H. Harland names David Passman CFO.
newsitem.headline: John H. Harland names David Passman CFO.

text.p: John H. Harland Co said on Monday that it has named S. David Passman III to senior vice president and chief financial officer.
In addition to overall financial management of the company, Passman will play a major role in developing and implementing Harland's business strategies.
Passman replaces William Dollar who was promoted to vice president of finance and treasurer.

"David brings to Harland an impressive combination of more than 20 years financial management experience and a strategic vision that complements our own," said Robert Amman, president and chief executive, in a statement.
Prior to joining Harland, Passman managed the Atlanta office of Deloitte & Touche LLP.
Harland is a supplier of checks, database marketing services and loan automation software to the financial industry.
